title: B1 Milestone 3: Review Test
completion_message: ¡Felicidades! Has superado el Tercer Hito del Nivel B1. Estás avanzando a paso firme en tu inglés corporativo.

parts.visual:
En esta prueba repasaremos las lecciones 11 a 14 del nivel B1: 
- First Conditional (If we drop the price, we will sell more). 
- Marketing Vocab (Target audience, campaign, launch).
parts.audio: In this test we will review lessons 11 to 14 of the B1 level: The First Conditional for real possibilities, and Marketing vocabulary.

parts.visual:
- Comparing Options (As fast as, more efficient than, cheaper than). 
- Business Travel (Itinerary, layover, expenses, reimbursement). 
¡Buena suerte!
parts.audio: We will also review how to compare options, and vocabulary for Business Travel. Good luck!

stages.title: Milestone Quiz
stages.description: Elige la respuesta correcta en este desafío integrador (Lecciones 11-14).

questions.question: If we launch the campaign today, we ____ see results next week. (Veremos).
questions.explanation: Primer condicional: If + presente (launch), consecuencia con will (will see).

questions.question: If she ____ the contract, we will start working. (Firma).
Who is our ____ audience for this product? (Público objetivo).
Our goal is to increase brand ____. (Reconocimiento de marca).
We need to ____ the event on social media. (Promocionar).
This software is ____ that one. (Tan rápido como).
Option A is ____ than Option B. (Más eficiente).
Working from home is ____ than going to the office. (Mejor - irregular).
I need to check my ____ to see the flight times. (Itinerario).
Please show your ____ pass. (Pase de abordar).
We have a two-hour ____ in Paris. (Escala).
Don't forget to keep your ____ to get your money back. (Recibos).
The company will give you a ____ for the hotel. (Reembolso de viáticos).
If you ____ the deadline, they will cancel the order. (No cumples/Pierdes).
What ____ you do if they reject the offer? (¿Qué harás...?).
They hired an advertising ____ to make the video. (Agencia).
Their slogan is very ____. (Pegadizo).
The results are ____ than we thought. (Peores - irregular).
This campaign was ____ successful than the last one. (Menos).
I only travel with ____ luggage to save time. (Equipaje de mano).

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Completa el repaso escribiendo la palabra correcta.

questions.question: If we drop the price, we ____ sell more. (Auxiliar futuro)
____ audience. (Público objetivo)
Brand ____. (Reconocimiento de marca)
It is ____ fast as yours. (Tan)
It is ____ expensive than yours. (Más)
It is ____ than yours. (Mejor - de good)
Check your ____. (Itinerario)
We have a ____ in Paris. (Escala)
Keep your ____. (Recibos)
Ask for a ____. (Reembolso de viáticos)

stages.title: Listening Comprehension
stages.description: Escucha y selecciona la frase de tu examen final.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: If we drop the price, we will sell more.
options: If we drop the price, we will sell more.
If we drop the price, we sell more.
If we drop the price, we would sell more.
If we drop the price, we won't sell more.
questions.correct_answer: If we drop the price, we will sell more.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: We need to do market research.
options: We need to do market research.
I need to do market research.
We need to do a market study.
We have to do market research.
questions.correct_answer: We need to do market research.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: Our product is as good as theirs.
options: Our product is as good as theirs.
Our product is good as theirs.
Our product is better than theirs.
Their product is as good as ours.
questions.correct_answer: Our product is as good as theirs.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: Working from home is better than commuting.
options: Working from home is better than commuting.
Working from home is worse than commuting.
Working from home is as good as commuting.
Working from home is easier than commuting.
questions.correct_answer: Working from home is better than commuting.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: I need to check my itinerary.
options: I need to check my itinerary.
I need to print my itinerary.
We need to check the itinerary.
I need to check my schedule.
questions.correct_answer: I need to check my itinerary.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: We have a layover in Frankfurt.
options: We have a layover in Frankfurt.
I have a layover in Frankfurt.
They have a layover in Frankfurt.
We had a layover in Frankfurt.
questions.correct_answer: We have a layover in Frankfurt.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: The company will process your reimbursement.
options: The company will process your reimbursement.
The company will process your refund.
questions.correct_answer: The company will process your reimbursement.
